title: Resolution, aspect ratio and the pixel budget
hook: From an aspect ratio and a pixel budget to a size the VAE accepts: the square-root formula, what ComfyUI's size nodes round to, and how fast attention and VAE costs grow.

verified.claim: EmptyLatentImage takes 16 to 16384 in steps of 8, default 1024, and divides by 8.
The server checks min and max. No step check appears in validate_inputs.
ImageScaleToTotalPixels uses the square root, and rounds to resolution_steps.
The graph passes validate_prompt and ran on a CPU.
The 40 sizes are typed from Appendix I of the SDXL paper. The browser lab uses the same list, compared by script against the lab's list.
The memory numbers come from the formula in comfy/sd.py and are estimates.

unchecked: Nothing here tests picture quality at any size.
We did not measure real memory use at each size.
